title: Passion & embracing the journey - Marianne's Summer Soundbites - 1

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换金钱之外还能赚取其他收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent），从2019年开始，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我专属的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福南梅森（Fortnum and Mason）礼品，以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast,
sentences.zh: 在今天播出的《有志心理学家》播客中，

sentences.en: I am guiding you through two important steps that can help you think about weathering the storm on your journey to becoming whatever type of aspiring psychologist you fancy being.
sentences.zh: 我将引导你经历两个重要的步骤，帮助你思考在成为你心仪的任何类型心理学家的道路上，如何经受住风雨。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: If you have been listening to the podcast for a little while, you might well recall the Pauly Wing series of episodes,
sentences.zh: 如果你听这个播客有一段时间了，你可能还记得保利·温格（Pauly Wing）系列的单集，

sentences.en: which is where I was wearing my arm in a sling because I had recently broken my arm.
sentences.zh: 当时我的胳膊戴着吊带，因为我最近胳膊骨折了。

sentences.en: I thought it was about time we did another little series.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是时候做另一个系列了。

sentences.en: And this series is going to be called Marianne's Summer Soundvites.
sentences.zh: 这个系列将被称为“玛丽安的夏日精选音频”。

sentences.en: We're going to be looking at a series of important but smaller topics.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨一系列重要但较小的话题。

sentences.en: This is a great way for you to stay on track with your psychology goals and commitment, even when you might be busier over the summer period.
sentences.zh: 这是你保持心理学目标和承诺的好方法，即使你在夏天可能比较忙碌。

sentences.en: All of these Marianne's Summer Soundvites episodes will just begin.
sentences.zh: 所有这些“玛丽安的夏日精选音频”单集都将刚刚开始。

sentences.en: But don't worry, this isn't a long-term change.
sentences.zh: 不过别担心，这不是长期的改变。

sentences.en: The usual format of long episodes, including guest episodes that I know you love, will be back along in the autumn.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们喜欢的那种长单集（包括嘉宾单集）的常规形式，将在秋天回归。

sentences.en: And there might also be some over the summer period too.
sentences.zh: 夏天期间可能也会有一些。

sentences.en: So, before we crack on, let me guide you through another little series that is coming.
sentences.zh: 因此，在我们开始之前，让我引导你们了解即将推出的另一个小系列。

sentences.en: And again, if you've been in my world a while, you might well already know about the free Compassionate Q&A sessions.
sentences.zh: 同样的，如果你进入我的世界有一段时间了，你可能已经知道免费的同理心问答环节了。

sentences.en: They are absolutely free sessions I've been running live across all of my socials on weekday evenings during application and interview seasons.
sentences.zh: 这些是我在申请和面试季的工作日晚上，在我的所有社交平台上进行直播的绝对免费的环节。

sentences.en: And the great news is that they are back for the interview season and I've got the dates to share with you now.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，它们将在面试季回归，我现在就和大家分享日期。

sentences.en: So, as you can see on your screen, we have the first of those coming up on Monday the 4th of September 2023.
sentences.zh: 如你在屏幕上所见，其中第一个将于2023年9月4日星期一举行。

sentences.en: And that starts at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 那是从晚上6点开始。

sentences.en: A replay will of course be available too.
sentences.zh: 当然也会提供回放。

sentences.en: And the best place to find the replay is Dr. Marianne Trent on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 找到回放的最佳去处是YouTube上的玛丽安·特伦特博士频道。

sentences.en: The second of the sessions is Tuesday, the 3rd of October 2023, also at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 第二场会议是2023年10月3日星期二，同样是在晚上6点。

sentences.en: Again, a replay is available.
sentences.zh: 同样，提供回放。

sentences.en: And the third and final session to support application season for the Declin side, but also Ed side is also a similar time of year,
sentences.zh: 支持临床心理学博士（Declin）以及教育心理学博士（Ed side）申请季的第三场也是最后一场会议也在一年中的相似时间，

sentences.en: is going to be Tuesday the 7th of November 2023 at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 将是2023年11月7日星期二晚上6点。

sentences.en: So, don't wait, don't delay, connect with me on socials now, so that you can dive right in when the time comes.
sentences.zh: 所以，不要等待，不要拖延，现在就在社交平台上与我联系，以便在时机成熟时直接深入了解。

sentences.en: On LinkedIn, I am Dr. Marianne Trent, come and connect or follow.
sentences.zh: 在领英（LinkedIn）上，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，快来连接或关注我吧。

sentences.en: On Twitter, I'm also Dr. Marianne Trent, although on Twitter I can't see your comments because StreamYard and Twitter don't integrate properly.
sentences.zh: 在推特（Twitter）上，我也是玛丽安·特伦特博士，尽管在推特上我看不到你们的评论，因为StreamYard和推特没有完美整合。

sentences.en: But if you want to just watch from Twitter, you absolutely can.
sentences.zh: 但如果你只想从推特观看，完全可以。

sentences.en: On YouTube, I am Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 在YouTube上，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: My Facebook page is also Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我的Facebook主页也是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: And last but of course, not the least, come and join my free Facebook community group, which is called The Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 最后但当然同样重要的是，来加入我的免费Facebook社群小组，它叫做“与玛丽安·特伦特博士一起的有志心理学家社群”。

sentences.en: I do always endeavour to get live on Instagram as well, but it's not quite so interactive because it means I have to get my phone rigged up behind my lip cam.
sentences.zh: 我一直努力也在Instagram上进行直播，但互动性没那么好，因为这意味着我必须把手机固定在唇麦后面。

sentences.en: It's a little bit rustic, but you absolutely should be able to catch it there too.
sentences.zh: 这有点简陋，但你绝对也应该能在那里看到它。

sentences.en: And on Instagram and on threads, I am Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 在Instagram和Threads上，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: So come and follow me everywhere, do a blanket approach, be much appreciated.
sentences.zh: 所以到处关注我吧，采取全方位的方法，非常感谢。

sentences.en: So let's not wish the summer away, let's make it a really mindful and enjoyable one.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们不要盼着夏天快点过去，让我们过一个真正正念且愉快的夏天。

sentences.en: Let's get back to Marianne's soundbites.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到玛丽安的音频。

sentences.en: So the first thing I would like you to consider and be mindful and aware of is just how much your passion matters.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想让你考虑并保持正念和意识的第一件事是，你的热情是多么重要。

sentences.en: It can be really tricky on this aspiring psychologist journey to play the long game,
sentences.zh: 在这个有志心理学家的旅程中，进行一场长期的博弈真的很棘手，

sentences.en: to have a long-burning, slow-burning fuse where you hope that there will eventually be some spectacular and worthwhile fireworks.
sentences.zh: 点燃一根燃烧缓慢的引信，希望最终能有壮观且值得的烟花。

sentences.en: During that time, it's really understandable and normal if your passion and commitment can feel like they wane or waver a little bit.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，如果你的热情和承诺感到有点减弱或动摇，这是非常可以理解和正常的。

sentences.en: Genuinely, from my own experiences, I felt that I always had my eye on that goal, and that was something I always wanted.
sentences.zh: 说实话，从我自己的经历来看，我觉得我一直盯着那个目标，那是我一直想要的。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, my long-term goal never, never did waver.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我的长期目标从未、从未动摇过。

sentences.en: And, you know, my commitment to ensuring that the clients I worked with had good, safe, effective service.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我致力于确保我合作的客户拥有良好、安全、有效的服务。

sentences.en: Ran throughout everything that I did, and I'm sure the same is true for you too.
sentences.zh: 贯穿了我所做的每一件事，我相信对你来说也是如此。

sentences.en: If you feel like you're becoming a little bit less passionate, then make sure that you have taken your annual leave at regular points throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得自己的热情正在变得不那么高涨，那么请确保你在全年的定期时间里休了年假。

sentences.en: Because when our passion disappears, it can be a sign, an early indicator of burnout.
sentences.zh: 因为当我们的热情消失时，这可能是一个信号，是倦怠的早期指标。

sentences.en: Nobody does this job for the money.
sentences.zh: 没有人是为了钱而做这份工作的。

sentences.en: And so, really, it is your dedication and your passion and commitment to having people's lives to be more free from distress that is just incredible.
sentences.zh: 所以，真的，正是你的奉献精神、热情以及让人们摆脱痛苦的生活的承诺，才是如此不可思议。

sentences.en: Your determination to support their mental well-being is so admirable.
sentences.zh: 你支持他们心理健康的坚定决心是如此令人钦佩。

sentences.en: Being able to make a meaningful, lasting impact upon people never gets old.
sentences.zh: 能够对人们产生有意义的、持久的影响，永远不会过时。

sentences.en: So, well done, you.
sentences.zh: 所以，你真棒。

sentences.en: Your passion really does matter, and I hope that it doesn't go unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 你的热情真的很重要，我希望它不会被忽视。

sentences.en: Let's take a brief moment here to have a little sing-song, and I'll be back with another of Marianne's Summer Soundbites.
sentences.zh: 在这里花一点时间唱一小段歌，我将带着玛丽安的另一个夏日精选音频回来。

sentences.en: Well, I just love those jingles.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我就是喜欢那些小曲儿。

sentences.en: I do feel like perhaps we ought to have done a Summer Soundbites jingle, but, you know, make your own up.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得也许我们应该做一个夏日精选音频的小曲儿，但是，你知道的，自己编一个吧。

sentences.en: And come back to me if you've come up with a good one.
sentences.zh: 如果你想出了一个不错的，欢迎回来告诉我。

sentences.en: I hope you found the first half of the first episode of Marianne's Summer Soundbites useful and thought-provoking.
sentences.zh: 我希望你觉得玛丽安的夏日精选音频第一集的前半部分很有用且引人深思。

sentences.en: What did it evoke for you?
sentences.zh: 它唤起了你怎样的感受？

sentences.en: Do come and let me know in my free Facebook group,
sentences.zh: 快来我的免费Facebook小组告诉我吧，

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Community.
sentences.zh: “有志心理学家社群”。

sentences.en: The second of my musings for today is all about embracing your journey.
sentences.zh: 我今天的第二个思考全部关于拥抱你的旅程。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, yes, I know.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，我知道。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: It's the sort of thing that you get on the front of a notebook, but I really do think it's really important.
sentences.zh: 这是那种你会写在笔记本封面的话，但我真的觉得它非常重要。

sentences.en: We need to remind ourselves that becoming a psychologist is a process, that there might well be shifts, even really tiny, you know, psychological shifts,
sentences.zh: 我们需要提醒自己，成为一名心理学家是一个过程，可能会有转变，甚至是微小的，你知道的，心理上的转变，

sentences.en: internal shifts within ourselves, that you might not even notice on a day-to-day basis, but you might certainly notice on month-to-month and year-to-year basis
sentences.zh: 我们内在的转变，你可能在日常生活中甚至都不会注意到，但你肯定会在月复一月和年复一年的基础上注意到，

sentences.en: that will be the difference that makes the difference.
sentences.zh: 这将是带来不同的大不同。

sentences.en: We really do have to be able to embrace the learning opportunities, challenges, the growth of things that feel tricky along the way.
sentences.zh: 我们真的必须能够拥抱学习的机会、挑战、以及沿途感觉棘手的事情的成长。

sentences.en: We have to keep the faith, you know?
sentences.zh: 我们必须保持信念，你知道吗？

sentences.en: You might not be a Bon Jovi fan, but there's a song called Keep the Faith that I think is quite relevant here.
sentences.zh: 你可能不是邦·乔维（Bon Jovi）的粉丝，但有一首歌叫《保持信念》（Keep the Faith），我觉得在这里很切题。

sentences.en: Even though it's tricky, even though you might have had setbacks, even though there might have been days where you felt, well, this is really hard,
sentences.zh: 即使很棘手，即使你可能遭遇了挫折，即使可能有些日子你觉得，嗯，这真的很难，

sentences.en: keeping the faith and keeping on heading towards that goal that's so important to you is important.
sentences.zh: 保持信念并继续朝着对你如此重要的目标前进是很重要的。

sentences.en: If it matters to you, then it matters.
sentences.zh: 如果它对你重要，那么它就很重要。

sentences.en: Each and every step you take is bringing you closer to where you want to be.
sentences.zh: 你迈出的每一步都让你更接近你想去的地方。

sentences.en: And if you feel that it's not, then maybe it's time for a shake-up with a new supervisor or a new job role.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得没有，那么也许是时候通过一个新的主管或一个新的职位来做出改变了。

sentences.en: And always remember, you can come and grab my free supervision shaping tool from my website, www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk forward slash supervision.
sentences.zh: 永远记住，你可以从我的网站www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk/supervision获取我免费的督导塑造工具。

sentences.en: So I hope you found the first in our series of Marianne Summer Soundbite podcast episodes used.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你觉得我们玛丽安夏日精选音频播客系列的第一集很有用。

sentences.en: If some more expert care and guidance in your journey towards becoming an aspiring clinical psychologist would be useful,
sentences.zh: 如果在你成为有志临床心理学家的旅程中，需要更多专家关怀和指导，

sentences.en: do consider joining us in the aspiring psychologist membership from just £30 a month with no income commitment.
sentences.zh: 请考虑加入我们的有志心理学家会员计划，每月仅需30英镑起，无需收入承诺。

sentences.en: And you can get more information about that by going to my website or by clicking the bio link in any of my socials.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过访问我的网站或点击我任何社交平台上的个人简介链接来获取更多相关信息。

sentences.en: If you're watching on YouTube, you can check out the links in the description too.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，你也可以查看简介中的链接。

sentences.en: Whilst we're talking about YouTube, you might well have noticed, if you've watched the last few episodes, that there's a slightly different feel to the YouTube.
sentences.zh: 在我们谈论YouTube的时候，如果你看过最近的几集，你可能已经注意到YouTube有一种略有不同的感觉。

sentences.en: There's more to watch, there's more going on.
sentences.zh: 有更多可看的，有更多正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: It's not just me and my guests talking anymore.
sentences.zh: 不再只是我和我的嘉宾在谈话了。

sentences.en: So if you haven't watched it for a while, do head over to Dr Marianne Trent on YouTube and give it a while.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有一段时间没看过了，快去YouTube上的玛丽安·特伦特博士频道看看吧。

sentences.en: And whilst you're there, like, share, comment, engage, do all those great things.
sentences.zh: 趁你在那里的同时，点赞、分享、评论、互动，做所有那些棒极了的事情。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for taking the time in your busy day to listen to this episode and to keep thinking about your goals for psychology, for your career,
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你在繁忙的日程中抽出时间来听这一集，并继续思考你对心理学、对你的职业生涯的目标，

sentences.en: and hopefully also for your personal and professional growth too.
sentences.zh: 也希望对你的个人和职业成长有所思考。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you for the next episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast, which will be along to you from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我期待着在《有志心理学家》播客的下一集中与你相聚，该节目将于周一上午6点准时向你播出。

sentences.en: Thanks for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist,
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，

sentences.en: then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 那么让这成为你的指南。

sentences.en: With this podcast, it's your side to be on your way to being qualified.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客，它伴你左右，让你在通往合格的路上。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这是《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换金钱之外还能赚取其他收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，从2019年开始，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两届心理学家走过他们的历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我专属的支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福南梅森礼品，以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday, the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
